rows.tie_quote: I am an Assistant Professor of Computer Science at the University of Maryland, College Park
rows.reason: Discovery selected a department news article (cs.umd.edu/article/2026/10/alan-liu-helps-lead-173m-nsf-programmable-cloud-lab-node-biomanufacturing, a research-output/news page) because the department profile https://www.cs.umd.edu/people/zaoxing links both it and his homepage. The homepage https://zaoxing.github.io/ (stored live capture 2026-11-24, sha256 above, HTTP 200, robots read first) is his own page: it is titled "Alan Zaoxing Liu - Homepage - University of Maryland", names him as Assistant Professor and leads the FROOT lab.

Listed Assistant Professor in the CS department 2016-2017 only. His department profile (Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20170809134331id_/https://cs.umd.edu/people/zia1138, sha256 3a29299fd718d873df8ebfccd6259d49d71fffcfdc9f05cf34536573f29801d4) carries the field "Website: http://www.umiacs.umd.edu/~zia". That address is only a redirect stub (Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20140402210517id_/http://www.umiacs.umd.edu:80/~zia/, sha256 f864c8bf222c53884e6659151e0bb0edbae5d3ff26189f838e5093f41f1e3205: "You can access my homepage here", meta refresh to http://www.cs.umd.edu/~zia). That UMD-era homepage address http://www.cs.umd.edu/~zia now redirects to https://www.cs.princeton.edu/people/forwarding/zkhan, a Princeton CS "This person has moved" page (live fetch stored 2026-11-25, sha256 1835c0486183e045d212f5ae05e8416c4c6c69017b35af8313dd8877c22a82a1). The school-era site is gone and the live site is at another institution; no UMD-era homepage content is stored.
